instruction: How many tiles are in a standard Mahjong set? Answer with only the number.

corpus.How many total possible opening moves ar: White has 20 total possible opening moves in chess: each of the eight pawns can move one or two squares forward (giving 16 pawn moves), and each of the two knights can move to two different squares (giving 4 knight moves). No other pieces can move on the first turn because they are blocked by the pawns. This gives the first player a significant choice that shapes the entire direction of the game.
corpus.How many tiles are in a standard Mahjong: A standard Mahjong set contains 144 tiles, comprising 36 character tiles, 36 bamboo tiles, 36 circle tiles, 16 wind tiles, 12 dragon tiles, and 8 bonus tiles (4 flowers and 4 seasons). The game originated in China during the Qing dynasty and involves players drawing and discarding tiles to form specific combinations. Regional variants may use slightly different tile sets.
corpus.How many playable intersections are on a: A standard Go board has 361 playable intersections, formed by a grid of 19 horizontal and 19 vertical lines. Players place stones on these intersections rather than inside the squares. The 19x19 board is used for professional and tournament play, while smaller 9x9 and 13x13 boards are common for beginners and shorter games.
corpus.How many unique two-card starting hands: There are 1326 unique two-card starting hands in Texas Hold'em poker, calculated as the combination of 52 cards taken 2 at a time. However, when considering that suits are interchangeable for unpaired hands, there are only 169 strategically distinct starting hands. The strongest starting hand is a pair of aces, while the weakest is generally considered to be 7-2 offsuit.
corpus.How many total dominoes are in a double-: A double-nine domino set contains 55 tiles, covering all possible pairings of values from zero through nine. This is significantly larger than the standard double-six set of 28 tiles and allows for more players and more complex games. The number of tiles in any double-n set follows the triangular number formula (n+1)(n+2)/2.
corpus.How many letter tiles have zero point va: Scrabble includes 2 blank tiles that have zero point value and can represent any letter of the alphabet. Blank tiles are among the most valuable tiles in the game despite scoring no points themselves because of their flexibility in forming high-scoring words. Once a blank is placed on the board and designated as a specific letter, it remains that letter for the rest of the game.
corpus.How many railroad spaces are on a standa: A standard Monopoly board has 4 railroad spaces: Reading Railroad, Pennsylvania Railroad, B&O Railroad, and Short Line. Each railroad costs $200 to purchase, and the rent increases with each additional railroad owned by the same player, from $25 for one up to $200 for all four. Railroads are among the most profitable investments in Monopoly relative to their cost.
corpus.How many property groups (color sets) ar: Standard Monopoly has 8 property groups organized by color: brown (dark purple), light blue, pink, orange, red, yellow, green, and dark blue. Each color group contains two or three properties that must all be owned by the same player before houses and hotels can be built. The orange properties are statistically the most profitable due to their proximity to the Jail square.
corpus.How many cards does each player receive: Each player receives 13 cards in a standard game of Bridge, as the entire 52-card deck is dealt equally among four players. Players are seated in two partnerships opposite each other, and the game involves bidding for contracts and then playing the hand. Bridge is considered one of the most complex and strategic card games.
corpus.How many discs does each player start wi: Each player starts with 2 discs in Othello, placed in the center of the 8x8 board in a diagonal pattern with alternating colors. The discs are two-sided, with one black and one white face. Players take turns placing discs to outflank and flip their opponent's pieces. The player with the most discs of their color when the board is full wins.
corpus.How many pieces does each player have in: Each player has 15 pieces (called checkers or stones) in Backgammon, distributed across specific points on the board at the start of the game. Players roll dice and move their checkers around the board in opposite directions, aiming to bear off all their pieces before their opponent. Backgammon is one of the oldest known board games, with origins dating back approximately 5,000 years.
corpus.How many points are on a standard Backga: A standard Backgammon board has 24 points (narrow triangles) arranged in four quadrants of six points each. The points are alternately colored and are numbered 1 through 24, with each player counting from opposite ends of the board. The bar in the center divides the board into the home and outer boards for each player.
corpus.How many territory cards are in the boar: The board game Risk contains 42 territory cards, one for each territory on the board. Each card shows the territory name and one of three symbols: infantry, cavalry, or artillery. Players receive territory cards for conquering at least one territory during their turn and can trade in matching sets for bonus armies.
corpus.How many hexagonal tiles are in the base: The base Catan board consists of 19 hexagonal tiles arranged in a roughly circular pattern. These include one desert tile that produces no resources and 18 resource-producing tiles: 4 forests (lumber), 4 pastures (wool), 4 fields (grain), 3 hills (brick), and 3 mountains (ore). The tiles are arranged randomly at the start of each game to create a unique board.
corpus.How many resource types are in the base: The base Settlers of Catan features 5 resource types: lumber, wool, grain, brick, and ore. Players collect these resources based on the placement of their settlements and cities adjacent to hexagonal terrain tiles. Different combinations of resources are needed to build roads, settlements, cities, and development cards, requiring players to trade with each other to acquire what they need.
corpus.How many letter S tiles are in a standar: A standard English Scrabble set contains 4 letter S tiles, each worth one point. The S tile is highly valuable strategically because it can be added to the end of existing words on the board to form plurals, simultaneously creating a new word. Experienced players often save S tiles for high-scoring opportunities rather than using them in routine plays.
corpus.How many cards are in a standard Uno dec: A standard Uno deck contains 108 cards in total, comprising numbered cards (0-9) in four colors, action cards (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two in each color), and wild cards. The game was created in 1971 by Merle Robbins and has become one of the best-selling card games in the world. Players aim to be the first to empty their hand by matching cards by color or number.
corpus.How many maximum points can be scored in: The maximum points that can be scored in a single turn in Yahtzee is 50, achieved by rolling five of a kind (a Yahtzee). If a player rolls a Yahtzee and the Yahtzee category has already been scored, bonus Yahtzees are worth 100 additional points each, but only if the player's corresponding upper section box has been filled. Yahtzee is a dice game played with five dice.
corpus.How many categories are scored in a stan: A standard Yahtzee game has 13 scoring categories that must each be filled exactly once during the game. The upper section has six categories (Ones through Sixes) that sum specific die values, while the lower section has seven categories including Three of a Kind, Four of a Kind, Full House, Small Straight, Large Straight, Chance, and Yahtzee.
corpus.How many total squares can be found on a: A chessboard contains 204 total squares when counting squares of all possible sizes. This includes 64 individual 1x1 squares, 49 squares of size 2x2, 36 of size 3x3, 25 of size 4x4, 16 of size 5x5, 9 of size 6x6, 4 of size 7x7, and 1 square of size 8x8. The calculation follows the sum of squares formula: the sum of n-squared from 1 to 8.
corpus.How many unique ways can the first four: There are 71852 unique ways the first four moves of chess can be played, counting two moves by each player (four half-moves total). After White's first move (20 options) and Black's response (20 options), each side has an increasing number of possibilities based on piece development. This rapid expansion of possibilities is one reason chess has never been computationally solved.
corpus.How many dice are used in a game of Yaht: Yahtzee is played with 5 dice, which players roll up to three times per turn to achieve specific combinations. After the first roll, the player may set aside any dice and re-roll the remaining ones. After three rolls, or when the player is satisfied, the result must be recorded in one of the thirteen scoring categories on the scorecard.
corpus.How many rooms are in the board game Clu: The board game Clue contains 9 rooms where the fictional murder may have taken place: the Kitchen, Ballroom, Conservatory, Billiard Room, Library, Study, Hall, Lounge, and Dining Room. Players move between rooms to make suggestions about the murder suspect, weapon, and room. The game was first published in 1949 in the United Kingdom under the name Cluedo.
corpus.How many suspect characters are in the b: The board game Clue features 6 suspect characters: Miss Scarlet, Colonel Mustard, Mrs. White, Reverend Green, Mrs. Peacock, and Professor Plum. Each player takes on the role of one suspect and moves around the board to gather clues. The objective is to deduce which suspect committed the murder, with which weapon, and in which room.
corpus.How many weapon cards are in the board g: The board game Clue contains 6 weapon cards corresponding to six miniature weapon tokens: the candlestick, knife, lead pipe, revolver, rope, and wrench. One weapon card is placed in the confidential case file along with one suspect and one room card to form the solution. Players eliminate possibilities through the process of making suggestions and receiving cards from other players.
corpus.How many letter E tiles are in a standar: A standard English Scrabble set contains 12 letter E tiles, making E the most abundant letter in the game. Each E tile is worth only one point, reflecting the letter's high frequency in English. The large number of E tiles means they are commonly available for rack balancing, though having too many can be a disadvantage since they limit high-scoring consonant combinations.
corpus.How many victory points do you need to w: A player needs 10 victory points to win the base game of Settlers of Catan. Points can be earned through building settlements (1 point each), upgrading to cities (2 points each), holding the Longest Road card (2 points), holding the Largest Army card (2 points), and through certain development cards that award 1 victory point each.
corpus.How many harbors are on the standard Cat: The standard Catan board features 9 harbors placed around the coastline of the island. Five of these are generic 3-for-1 harbors that allow trading any three of one resource for one of any other. The remaining four are specialized 2-for-1 harbors, each dedicated to a specific resource type, providing a more favorable trading ratio.
corpus.How many development cards are in base C: The base game of Settlers of Catan includes 25 development cards that players can purchase for specific resource combinations. The development deck consists of 14 Knight cards, 5 Victory Point cards, 2 Road Building cards, 2 Monopoly cards, and 2 Year of Plenty cards. Development cards provide various strategic advantages and are drawn face-down from a shuffled pile.
corpus.How many knight cards are in a base Cata: A base Catan development deck contains 14 Knight cards, making them the most common development card type. Playing a Knight card allows the player to move the robber to a new hex and steal a resource from an adjacent player. Accumulating three or more Knights earns the Largest Army bonus worth 2 victory points, which is contested throughout the game.
corpus.How many stones does Black place first i: Black places 1 stone first in a game of Go, as the game begins with an empty board and Black always moves first. This first-move advantage is traditionally compensated by a scoring bonus called komi given to White, typically 6.5 or 7.5 points in modern rules. Go is considered one of the most complex board games, with more possible positions than atoms in the observable universe.
corpus.How many life points does each player st: Each player starts with 20 life points in standard Magic: The Gathering, and the primary way to win is to reduce your opponent's life total to zero. Players can also win by forcing their opponent to draw from an empty library or through special card abilities that state alternative win conditions. Magic was created by Richard Garfield and first published in 1993, becoming the world's first trading card game.
corpus.How many cards are in a standard Tarot d: A standard Tarot deck contains 78 cards, divided into two main groups. The Major Arcana consists of 22 cards representing significant life events and archetypes, while the Minor Arcana contains 56 cards divided into four suits of 14 cards each. Although commonly associated with divination, Tarot cards were originally designed for playing card games in 15th-century Europe.
corpus.How many Major Arcana cards are in a Tar: A Tarot deck contains 22 Major Arcana cards, numbered from 0 (The Fool) through 21 (The World). These cards depict significant archetypes and life themes such as The Magician, The High Priestess, The Empress, The Tower, and Death. In Tarot readings, Major Arcana cards are considered to carry greater significance than the 56 Minor Arcana cards.
corpus.How many tiles are in a standard set of: A standard Rummikub set contains 106 tiles: 104 numbered tiles in four colors (two sets of tiles numbered 1 through 13 in each of black, blue, orange, and red) plus 2 joker tiles. Players arrange tiles into runs of consecutive numbers in the same color or groups of the same number in different colors. The game was invented by Ephraim Hertzano in the 1940s.
corpus.How many letter Z tiles are in a standar: There is 1 letter Z tile in a standard English Scrabble set, and it is worth 10 points, tied with Q as the highest-valued tile. The single Z tile reflects the letter's rarity in English. Despite its scarcity, the Z tile can be very valuable when played on bonus squares, particularly triple-letter or triple-word score positions.
corpus.How many bonus squares are on a standard: A standard Scrabble board features 60 bonus squares distributed across the 15x15 grid. These include 24 double-letter score squares, 17 double-word score squares, 12 triple-letter score squares, and 8 triple-word score squares (including the center star, which counts as a double-word square). Strategic placement on these squares can dramatically increase a player's score.
corpus.How many double word score squares are o: A Scrabble board has 17 double word score squares, shown in light pink on standard boards. These include the center star square, which serves as both the starting position and a double-word square, and 16 additional squares arranged in diagonal lines radiating from the center. Landing on a double-word score square doubles the total value of all tiles in that word.
corpus.How many triple word score squares are o: A Scrabble board contains 8 triple word score squares, typically shown in dark red on standard boards. These squares are positioned at regular intervals around the edges of the board and in the four corners. Landing on a triple-word square triples the entire value of the word placed there, making these the most coveted positions for high-scoring plays.
corpus.How many total rectangles can be found o: A chessboard contains 1296 total rectangles when counting all possible rectangles of every size and orientation. This is calculated by choosing two horizontal lines and two vertical lines from the nine lines that form the grid, giving C(9,2) x C(9,2) = 36 x 36 = 1296. This count includes the 204 squares, since squares are a special case of rectangles.
corpus.How many dominoes are in a double-twelve: A double-twelve domino set contains 91 tiles, covering all possible pairings of values from zero (blank) through twelve. This makes it significantly larger than the standard double-six set (28 tiles) or the double-nine set (55 tiles). Double-twelve sets are popular for games with larger groups of players, as the additional tiles allow more participants.
corpus.How many cards are dealt face-up in the: In the initial Klondike Solitaire layout, 7 cards are dealt face-up, one atop each of the seven tableau columns. The first column has one card (face-up), the second has two cards (one face-down and one face-up), and so on, with the seventh column having six face-down cards and one face-up card. A total of 28 cards are used in the tableau, with the remaining 24 forming the stock pile.
corpus.How many possible first moves exist in C: There are 7 possible first moves in standard Checkers (also known as English Draughts). Since pieces can only move diagonally forward on dark squares, and the initial setup places pieces on rows 1-3, only four pieces in the front row can move, with some having two possible moves. Checkers has been played for thousands of years and was solved by computer in 2007, proving that perfect play by both sides results in a draw.
corpus.How many legal positions exist on a stan: There are 5478 legal positions on a standard tic-tac-toe board when counting all valid board states that can arise during play. This number includes both terminal and non-terminal positions. The total number of possible games is 255,168, though many of these are strategically equivalent due to symmetry. Tic-tac-toe is a solved game, guaranteed to end in a draw with optimal play from both sides.
corpus.How many different Tetris piece shapes (: There are 7 different Tetris piece shapes, known as tetrominoes, each consisting of four connected squares. The pieces are commonly designated by the letters they resemble: I, O, T, S, Z, L, and J. The I-piece is the only one that can clear four lines simultaneously (called a Tetris), making it the most sought-after piece in competitive play.
corpus.How many tiles are in a standard Azul ga: A standard Azul game includes 100 tiles distributed equally among five colors, with 20 tiles per color. Players take turns drafting colored tiles from shared factory displays and placing them on their personal pattern boards. The game was designed by Michael Kiesling and won the prestigious Spiel des Jahres award in 2018.
corpus.How many train cards does each player st: Each player starts with 4 train cards in Ticket to Ride, drawn from a deck of 110 cards. The deck consists of cards in eight different colors plus locomotive wild cards. Players collect and spend train cards to claim railway routes on the map, connecting cities to fulfill their destination ticket objectives for points.
corpus.How many development cards are in the ba: The base game of Settlers of Catan contains 25 development cards in total. These consist of 14 Knights, 5 Victory Point cards, 2 Road Building cards, 2 Year of Plenty cards, and 2 Monopoly cards. Development cards are purchased with one ore, one wool, and one grain, and must generally be held for at least one turn before being played.
corpus.How many knight cards are in the base Se: The base Settlers of Catan contains 14 Knight cards in the development card deck. Playing a Knight allows the active player to move the robber to a different hex tile and steal one random resource card from any player with a settlement or city adjacent to that hex. The player who has played the most Knights (minimum three) holds the Largest Army card worth 2 victory points.
corpus.How many harbor types are in the base Se: The base Settlers of Catan has 5 harbor types: one generic type and four resource-specific types. The generic harbors allow 3-for-1 trading of any single resource, while each specialized harbor offers 2-for-1 trading of its designated resource. Building a settlement on a harbor provides a permanent trading advantage that can significantly influence a player's strategy.
corpus.How many plague cubes of each color star: Pandemic starts with 24 plague cubes of each of the four colors (blue, yellow, black, and red) in the box, for a total of 96 cubes. During setup, cubes are placed on the board based on drawn infection cards, and more cubes are added each turn as diseases spread. If all 24 cubes of any one color are ever needed but unavailable, the players immediately lose the game.
corpus.How many action points does each player: Each player gets 4 action points per turn in Pandemic, which can be spent on moving between cities, treating diseases, sharing knowledge cards, building research stations, or discovering cures. Players must strategize carefully to use their limited actions effectively. After performing four actions, the player draws two player cards and then draws infection cards that spread disease on the board.
corpus.How many total letter tiles are in a sta: A standard Words With Friends game uses 104 letter tiles in total, including 2 blank tiles that can represent any letter. The tile distribution differs slightly from Scrabble, with different quantities and point values for some letters. For example, Words With Friends assigns higher values to certain common letters and features a 15x15 board with a different bonus square layout.
corpus.How many bonus squares are on a Words Wi: A Words With Friends board features 92 bonus squares spread across its 15x15 grid. These include double-letter, triple-letter, double-word, and triple-word score squares. The layout of bonus squares differs significantly from Scrabble, with the triple-word squares positioned differently and bonus squares placed more frequently throughout the center of the board.
corpus.How many spaces are on a standard Trivia: A standard Trivial Pursuit board has 73 spaces arranged in a wheel-and-spoke pattern. The outer ring connects to the center hub through six spokes, with category headquarters positioned at the intersections. Players move around the board answering questions in six categories to collect colored wedges for their playing piece, then must answer a final question at the hub to win.
corpus.How many category colors are in standard: Standard Trivial Pursuit features 6 category colors: blue (Geography), pink (Entertainment), yellow (History), brown (Art & Literature), green (Science & Nature), and orange (Sports & Leisure). Players must collect a wedge in each of the six categories by correctly answering questions when landing on category headquarters. The categories have remained largely consistent since the game's creation in 1979.
corpus.How many life tiles are in a standard Ga: The standard Game of Life includes 18 Life tiles that represent major life accomplishments and events. Players collect Life tiles by landing on certain spaces or achieving specific milestones during the game. At the end of the game, Life tiles are revealed and their values are added to each player's total cash to determine the winner.
corpus.How many weapon cards are in the board g: The board game Clue contains 6 weapon cards, each representing a different murder weapon: the candlestick, knife, lead pipe, revolver, rope, and wrench. At the start of each game, one weapon card is randomly placed in the confidential case file along with one suspect card and one room card. Players must deduce which weapon was used through the process of elimination.
corpus.How many total cards are in a standard C: A standard Clue game contains 21 cards in total: 6 suspect cards, 6 weapon cards, and 9 room cards. At the beginning of each game, one card from each category is randomly placed in the confidential case file to form the solution. The remaining 18 cards are dealt evenly among the players, who use deduction to determine the three hidden cards.
corpus.How many ships does each player have in: Each player has 5 ships in standard Battleship: the Carrier (5 holes), Battleship (4 holes), Cruiser (3 holes), Submarine (3 holes), and Destroyer (2 holes). Players secretly place their ships on a 10x10 grid, then take turns calling out coordinates to try to hit and sink their opponent's fleet. The first player to sink all five of the opponent's ships wins.
corpus.How many grid squares are on each Battle: Each Battleship board consists of 100 grid squares arranged in a 10x10 layout, with columns labeled A through J and rows numbered 1 through 10. Players have two grids: one for placing their own ships and one for tracking their shots against the opponent. The game requires strategic guessing and pattern recognition to efficiently locate and destroy all enemy ships.
corpus.How many property spaces does Monopoly h: Monopoly has 22 property spaces on its board, not including the 4 railroad spaces and 2 utility spaces. These 22 properties are organized into 8 color groups, ranging from the inexpensive brown (Mediterranean and Baltic) to the premium dark blue (Park Place and Boardwalk). Players can build houses and hotels on properties once they own all properties in a color group.
corpus.How many utility spaces are on a Monopol: A Monopoly board has 2 utility spaces: Electric Company and Water Works. Each utility costs $150 to purchase. The rent for utilities is determined by dice rolls: if a player owns one utility, the rent is 4 times the dice roll, and if they own both utilities, the rent increases to 10 times the dice roll.
corpus.How many total spaces does a player pass: A player passes 40 total spaces on one complete trip around the Monopoly board, returning to the Go square where they started. These spaces include 28 properties, 4 railroads, 2 utilities, and several special squares such as Chance, Community Chest, Income Tax, Luxury Tax, and the corner spaces (Go, Jail, Free Parking, and Go To Jail).
corpus.How many resource cards can a player hol: A player can hold up to 7 resource cards without discarding when a 7 is rolled in Settlers of Catan. Any player with more than 7 resource cards must discard half their hand (rounded down) when a 7 appears on the dice. This rule is designed to discourage hoarding resources and adds a risk-management element to the game.
corpus.How many points does a settlement earn i: A settlement earns 1 victory point in Settlers of Catan. Settlements are the primary means of expanding across the board and collecting resources. Each settlement must be placed at a board intersection with at least two empty intersections between it and any other settlement or city, following the distance rule that prevents overcrowding.
corpus.How many points does a city earn in Sett: A city earns 2 victory points in Settlers of Catan, replacing a settlement that was previously worth 1 point and adding a net gain of 1 victory point. Cities also double resource production from adjacent hexes compared to settlements. Upgrading a settlement to a city requires 3 ore and 2 grain, making these resources particularly valuable in the late game.
corpus.How many cards are in a standard Skip-Bo: A standard Skip-Bo deck contains 162 cards: 144 numbered cards (twelve each of the numbers 1 through 12) and 18 Skip-Bo wild cards. Each player receives a personal stockpile of 30 cards and the goal is to be the first to play all cards from the stockpile. Skip-Bo was created in 1967 and acquired by Mattel, who now publishes the game alongside Uno.
corpus.How many cards are in a standard Phase 1: A standard Phase 10 deck contains 108 cards, consisting of 96 numbered cards (two each of numbers 1 through 12 in four colors), 8 Wild cards, and 4 Skip cards. Players must complete ten specific phases in order, such as sets of matching numbers and runs of consecutive numbers. The game was created in 1982 and is published by Mattel.
corpus.How many different phases must be comple: A player must complete 10 different phases to win Phase 10, progressing through each phase in sequential order. The phases range from simple objectives like two sets of three to more challenging goals like a run of nine consecutive numbers. A player must successfully lay down the required combination during a hand to advance to the next phase.
corpus.How many tiles are in a standard Rummiku: A standard Rummikub set contains 106 tiles in total: 104 numbered tiles arranged in two sets of numbers 1 through 13 in each of four colors (black, blue, orange, and red), plus 2 joker tiles. Players draw tiles from a pool and arrange them on the table in valid runs and groups. Rummikub combines elements of the card game Rummy with tile-based gameplay.
corpus.How many numbered tiles of each color ar: Rummikub contains 26 numbered tiles of each color, consisting of two complete sets of tiles numbered 1 through 13. The four colors used are black, blue, orange, and red. Having duplicate tiles in each color allows for more complex combinations and strategies during gameplay, as players can use matching tiles to form groups of the same number in different colors.
